module: Link extension between quick race mode (scenario) and the Track Builder: when a scenario is loaded, it unloads the tracks in place, loads the scenario's custom track (sc.track.customData.name) via util_trackBuilder_splineTrack, adds the checkpoints and positions the vehicle, optionally in the reverse direction.
notes: A done flag avoids redoing the setup until onClientStartMission has been called again.
The arguments passed to load(…, true, true, true) are not named in this file; see splineTrack.

onScenarioLoaded.desc: Hook called when a scenario is loaded. If the setup is not already done: unloadAll, load of the scenario's track, addCheckPointPositions(reverse), positionVehicle(reverse).

sc.desc: Scenario; uses sc.track.customData.name (track name) and sc.track.reverse (reverse direction).

onClientStartMission.desc: Hook called at the start of a level load; resets the done flag to allow a new setup.
